unit.why: The division is a run of homilies on the weekly portions (Yitro through Shemini, Shekalim, Parah, Pesach, Tikkun Hatsot), quoted from Hasidic masters. It holds only exegesis, ethical teaching, a question-and-answer with an explanatory mashal, and a king parable used as illustration, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: The final Tikkun Hatsot teaching ends with an asterisk note marker; the next division continues the same anthology of sayings.
